decisions.statement: A draft is composed from the flags a send is composed from.
A subject or a body said both inline and in a file is refused.
`-` names standard input for one flag at most.
A draft comes back as its own id, its message's id and that message's thread.
A create that threw after Gmail took the draft says Gmail holds it.
Nothing here takes a draft back.
Every draft names a subject here or at `--subject-file`.
Every draft names a body here or at `--body-file`.

definition: the command writing one Gmail draft from the flags a send takes, unsent
